title: M5 stage32: implicit-zero tails to full anchored residue tuples
scope: Connect the finite tail-pair count in A to the full anchored tuple construction; preserve polynomial sum and integer gcd including empty/repeated tails.

spec.name: M5.ResidueTailBridge.anchor_zero
spec.statement: ∀ (T k : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (r : Fin k → Fin T), ∀ i : Fin (k + 1), i.val = 0 → (M5.ResidueTailBridge.anchored hT r i).val = 0
spec.guidance: An index with value0 equals0 by Fin.ext. Unfold anchored and use Fin.cons_zero. Return only tactic lines without leading by; keep exact target.

spec.name: M5.ResidueTailBridge.polynomial_cons
spec.statement: ∀ (T k : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (r : Fin k → Fin T), M5.SupportPolynomial.ofResidueTuple (M5.ResidueTailBridge.anchored hT r) = 1 + ∑ i : Fin k, (Polynomial.X : M5.BinaryPolynomial) ^ (r i).val
spec.guidance: Unfold ofResidueTuple and anchored; split sum over Fin(k+1) via Fin.sum_univ_succ, simplify Fin.cons_zero/cons_succ and X^0. Return only tactic lines without leading by; keep exact target.

spec.name: M5.ResidueTailBridge.gcd_cons
spec.statement: ∀ (T k : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (r : Fin k → Fin T), Finset.univ.gcd (fun i : Fin (k + 1) => (M5.ResidueTailBridge.anchored hT r i).val) = Finset.univ.gcd (fun i : Fin k => (r i).val)
spec.guidance: Use Nat.dvd_antisymm and Finset.dvd_gcd_iff, or equality of divisor predicates. Every Fin(k+1) index is zero or succ: atzero residue0 is divisible by every d; atsucc use tailgcd divisor. Conversely each tailresidue occurs atsucc. Fin.forall_fin_succ/Fin.cases can split indices. Do not assume distinct residues or k>0. Return only tactic lines without leading by; keep exact target.
